notes: National filings plus the prefectural and municipal tax returns for the prefecture of the head office.

items.name: Corporation Tax and Local Corporation Tax Return (final)
items.rule: Within 2 months after financial year end (a 1-month extension is available on application)
items.applies: Companies and branches
items.description: Filed with the financial statements; large companies must file by e-Tax.

items.name: Corporation Tax Interim Return
items.rule: Within 2 months after the first 6 months of the financial year
items.applies: Companies whose previous year's corporation tax was over ¥200,000
items.description: Half of last year's tax, or a provisional settlement of the first six months.

items.name: Annual Shareholders' Meeting and Public Notice of the Balance Sheet
items.rule: Within 3 months after financial year end
items.applies: Kabushiki Kaisha
items.description: The meeting approves the financial statements; the balance sheet is then published.

items.name: Commercial Registry Changes (directors, address, capital)
items.rule: Within 2 weeks of the change (director terms end after 2 years, or up to 10 for a non-public KK)
items.applies: Companies and branches
items.description: Re-appointing directors at the end of their term must be registered even when nothing else changes.

items.name: Consumption Tax Return (final)
items.rule: Within 2 months after financial year end
items.applies: Companies and branches that are taxable businesses
items.description: Registered invoice issuers file even when turnover is below ¥10 million.

items.name: Consumption Tax Interim Return
items.rule: Within 2 months after the first 6 months (quarterly or monthly for larger amounts)
items.applies: Taxable businesses whose previous year's national consumption tax was over ¥480,000
items.description: Interim payments based on last year's tax.

items.name: Consumption Tax Return (final)
items.rule: 31 March
items.applies: Sole proprietors that are taxable businesses
items.description: Filed for the previous calendar year.

items.name: Becoming a Taxable Business for Consumption Tax
items.rule: From the year after the base period's taxable sales pass ¥10 million (or on registering as an invoice issuer)
items.applies: Exempt businesses
items.description: A notification is filed with the tax office.

items.name: Final Income Tax Return (kakutei shinkoku)
items.rule: Between 16 February and 15 March
items.applies: Sole proprietors
items.description: Business income for the previous calendar year; blue-return filers attach the financial statements.

items.name: Withholding Income Tax and Resident Tax on Salaries
items.rule: 10th of the following month (employers with fewer than 10 staff may pay twice a year, by 10 July and 20 January)
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Income tax withheld goes to the tax office and resident tax to each employee's municipality.

items.name: Year-End Adjustment, Statutory Payment Records and Salary Payment Reports
items.rule: 31 January
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Withholding records go to the tax office and salary payment reports to each employee's municipality.

items.name: Health and Pension Insurance Premiums
items.rule: Last day of the following month
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Employer and employee premiums are paid to the Japan Pension Service.

items.name: Annual Standard Remuneration Report (santei kiso todoke)
items.rule: 10 July
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Reports April–June pay to reset each employee's insurance grade.

items.name: Labour Insurance Annual Renewal
items.rule: Between 1 June and 10 July
items.applies: Employers
items.description: Settles last year's workers' accident and employment insurance premiums and prepays this year's.
items.authority: Labour Bureau / Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare

items.name: Transfer Pricing — Schedule 17(4) and Local File
items.rule: With the corporation tax return
items.applies: Companies with foreign related-party transactions (contemporaneous local file from ¥5 billion of transactions, or ¥300 million of intangibles)
items.description: The schedule of foreign related-party transactions is attached to the return.

items.name: Foreign Investment Reports under the Foreign Exchange Act
items.rule: Prior notification or a report within 45 days of the investment, depending on the business sector
items.applies: Foreign investors acquiring shares in or lending to a Japanese company
items.description: Filed with the Bank of Japan.
items.authority: Bank of Japan / Ministry of Finance
